findings.description: The function configuration embeds an AWS access key ID and secret access key directly in environment variables. These values are stored in Terraform source/state and can be read by principals able to retrieve the Lambda configuration, creating a credential-exposure risk.

The function uses the nodejs12.x runtime, which is deprecated and no longer receives normal security patches. Running an unsupported runtime leaves the function exposed to unremediated runtime vulnerabilities.
